about: The job door's NAMED jobs (DGO-1797, package 9): what a linked office may ask this office to run. A job is an argv template — every argument is a fixed word or a {placeholder} whose value must match its pattern — never a shell string. v1 holds read-only bbox verbs only (class light: they take no heavy-job slot). JSON, not YAML: the server and the worker are standard library only.

bbox.what: a read-only bbox verb, in this office's own checkout
